BURNINGMOD-BURN_POWER.title: Burn
BURNINGMOD-BURN_POWER.description: Burning creatures take blockable damage at the end of their turn. Each turn, Burn is reduced by [blue]1[/blue].
BURNINGMOD-SMOLDERING_RAGE_POWER.title: Smoldering Rage
BURNINGMOD-SMOLDERING_RAGE_POWER.smartDe: Whenever [gold]Burn[/gold] is applied to you, apply [gold]Burn[/gold] equal to your Strength to ALL enemies.
BURNINGMOD-FORGED_IN_FLAME_POWER.title: Forged in Flame
BURNINGMOD-FORGED_IN_FLAME_POWER.smartDe: Whenever you apply [gold]Burn[/gold] to yourself, gain {Amount} [gold]Vigor[/gold] and {Amount} Block.
BURNINGMOD-TORCHBEARER_POWER.title: Torchbearer
BURNINGMOD-TORCHBEARER_POWER.smartDescri: Each turn, add a random [gold]Torch[/gold] card to your hand. It costs 0 this turn.
BURNINGMOD-KINDLE_POWER.title: Kindle
BURNINGMOD-KINDLE_POWER.description: When hit, apply [gold]Burn[/gold] to attacker. Expires end of turn.
BURNINGMOD-KINDLE_POWER.smartDescription: When hit, apply {Amount} [gold]Burn[/gold] to attacker. Expires end of turn.
BURNINGMOD-FIRE_BRAND_POWER.title: Fire Brand
BURNINGMOD-FIRE_BRAND_POWER.description: Applies Burn when Vulnerable is applied to an enemy.
BURNINGMOD-FIRE_BRAND_POWER.smartDescrip: Whenever [gold]Vulnerable[/gold] is applied to an enemy, also apply {Amount} [gold]Burn[/gold].
BURNINGMOD-FIRE_DIP_POWER.title: Fire Dip
BURNINGMOD-FIRE_DIP_POWER.description: Attacks apply Burn to the target this turn.
BURNINGMOD-FIRE_DIP_POWER.smartDescripti: Attacks apply {Amount} [gold]Burn[/gold] to the target this turn.
BURNINGMOD-CAUSTIC_FLAME_POWER.title: Caustic Flame
BURNINGMOD-COMBUSTION_TRAP_POWER.title: Combustion Trap
BURNINGMOD-COMBUSTION_TRAP_POWER.descrip: Next turn, apply Burn to all enemies.
BURNINGMOD-COMBUSTION_TRAP_POWER.smartDe: Next turn, apply {Amount} [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies.
BURNINGMOD-ARSONIST_POWER.title: Arsonist
BURNINGMOD-ARSONIST_POWER.description: At the start of enemies' turns, they lose HP equal to their Burn stacks.
BURNINGMOD-ARSONIST_POWER.smartDescripti: At the start of enemies' turns, they lose HP equal to their [gold]Burn[/gold] stacks.
BURNINGMOD-SMOLDERING_EDGE_POWER.title: Smoldering Edge
BURNINGMOD-SMOLDERING_EDGE_POWER.descrip: Each time you apply Burn, Shivs gain +1 damage this turn. Resets each turn.
BURNINGMOD-SMOLDERING_EDGE_POWER.smartDe: Each time you apply [gold]Burn[/gold], Shivs gain +1 damage this turn. Resets each turn.
BURNINGMOD-ETERNAL_FLAME_POWER.title: Eternal Flame
BURNINGMOD-ETERNAL_FLAME_POWER.descripti: Burn stacks on enemies no longer decrease.
BURNINGMOD-FLASHPOINT_POWER.title: Flashpoint
BURNINGMOD-FLASHPOINT_POWER.description: When any Orb evokes, deal 3 damage and apply 3 Burn to ALL enemies.
BURNINGMOD-FLASHPOINT_POWER.smartDescrip: When any Orb evokes, deal 3 damage and apply 3 [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies. Triggers {Amount} time(s).
BURNINGMOD-SCORCH_SELF_POWER.title: Scorch Self
BURNINGMOD-SCORCH_SELF_POWER.description: Whenever you draw a Burn, Channel 1 Fire Orb and gain 1 temporary Focus.
BURNINGMOD-SCORCH_SELF_POWER.smartDescri: Whenever you draw a [gold]Burn[/gold], Channel 1 [gold]Fire Orb[/gold] and gain 1 temporary [gold]Focus[/gold].
BURNINGMOD-THERMAL_SHIELD_POWER.title: Thermal Shield
BURNINGMOD-THERMAL_SHIELD_POWER.descript: Whenever you draw a Burn, gain Block.
BURNINGMOD-THERMAL_SHIELD_POWER.smartDes: Whenever you draw a [gold]Burn[/gold], gain {Amount} Block.
BURNINGMOD-INFERNAL_OVERLOAD_POWER.title: Inferno
BURNINGMOD-INFERNAL_OVERLOAD_POWER.descr: Whenever you Channel a Fire Orb, channel an Inferno Orb instead.
BURNINGMOD-INFERNAL_OVERLOAD_POWER.smart: Whenever you Channel a [gold]Fire Orb[/gold], channel an [gold]Inferno Orb[/gold] instead.
BURNINGMOD-HEAT_TRANSFER_POWER.title: Heat Transfer
BURNINGMOD-HEAT_TRANSFER_POWER.descripti: Whenever you Channel an Orb, apply Burn to a random enemy.
BURNINGMOD-HEAT_TRANSFER_POWER.smartDesc: Whenever you Channel an Orb, apply {Amount} [gold]Burn[/gold] to a random enemy.
BURNINGMOD-THAW_POWER.title: Thaw
BURNINGMOD-THAW_POWER.description: At the start of your next turn, Evoke all Frost Orbs, then Channel 1 Fire Orb for each evoked.
BURNINGMOD-THAW_POWER.smartDescription: At the start of your next turn, Evoke all [gold]Frost Orbs[/gold], then Channel 1 [gold]Fire Orb[/gold] for each evoked.
BURNINGMOD-RESONANT_FIELD_POWER.title: Resonant Field
BURNINGMOD-RESONANT_FIELD_POWER.descript: Triggers when you gain a new power.
BURNINGMOD-RESONANT_FIELD_POWER.smartDes: Whenever you gain a new power, Channel 1 [gold]Fire Orb[/gold] and apply {Amount} [gold]Burn[/gold] to ALL enemies.
